title: A realistic vertical smartphone travel p
prompt:
A realistic vertical smartphone travel photo in a 9:16 aspect ratio. An adult young woman stands on a tropical or subtropical forest path, surrounded by dense green plants, tree trunks, vines, fallen leaves, and a shadowed walkway broken by sunlight. She leans slightly toward the camera, her head shifted a little to the right, with one hand raised near her forehead in a relaxed two-finger gesture, as if she had just paused under the trees for a spontaneous photo. She looks naturally into the lens with clear relaxed eyes, a closed-lip soft smile, gentle cheeks, and a subtle dimple. The expression should feel intimate, confident, and unforced.

Preserve a soft oval face, natural eye shape, delicate nose bridge, full cheeks, clean skin, and slight smartphone beauty-filter softness. The makeup should follow an East Asian social-media / K-beauty travel aesthetic: translucent base, soft peach-pink blush, natural eyeliner, subtle under-eye softness, and rosy pink lips, without heavy contouring. Her hair is medium-long straight chestnut brown with a muted burgundy-purple undertone, lightly parted bangs, and ends falling over the shoulders and upper chest. It should have a slightly humid summer texture, a little naturally messy, with tiny leaf-filtered highlights on the crown. Black sunglasses rest on top of her head, and a black side bag with a pale printed shoulder strap appears along one side.

She wears a deep gray, slightly blue-purple, low-scoop sleeveless fitted mini dress or sporty one-piece. It has wide straps, a low rounded neckline, soft elastic fabric, natural tension curves around the chest, and horizontal wrinkles around the waist and abdomen from her leaning pose. The skirt has a side-tie or wrap-like detail. Visible skin includes the face, neck, collarbones, shoulders, both arms, underarm-adjacent area, upper chest/decolletage, and part of the upper thighs below the skirt hem. The waist, hips, back, and buttocks are mostly covered and should not be additionally exposed. Her skin tone is light warm with a peach-pink and pale golden outdoor cast. The skin should look smooth and soft to the touch, slightly warm from humid air, with a mild natural sheen on the shoulders, arms, collarbones, and upper chest, not plastic or over-smoothed.

The photo should feel like a close-range casual smartphone shot, around 24-28mm equivalent wide angle. Keep a mild wide-angle perspective so the raised arm and upper body feel closer to the viewer. The framing is a tight half-body to upper-thigh crop, with natural cropping of the raised arm, bag, and side edges, slightly shifted to the right rather than perfectly centered. Lighting is natural midday forest light: strong sun is broken by the tree canopy, creating irregular dappled highlights on the edge of the face, arms, collarbones, upper chest, and ground. Green foliage adds a faint cool bounce light, while shadows stay deep green and brown-black. Keep smartphone-photo imperfections such as local softness, slight motion blur, compression noise in the leaves, and a real unpolished travel-photo feeling. She had just lifted her hand against the sunlight, she is looking at the camera now, and she may laugh and keep walking in the next second.

Avoid: underage appearance, excessive nudity, explicit sexualization, exaggerated body proportions, plastic skin, studio lighting, perfectly symmetrical commercial composition, anime style, CGI look, mirror selfie, distorted fingers, and overly blurred background.
